# Load data

## Load libraries

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
```

## Gastro data

```{r}
gastro_proteomics <- read_tsv(
  "../data/_raw/motrpac_pass1b-06_t55-gastrocnemius_prot-pr_ratio-results_v2.0.txt"
)

gastro_metadata <- read_tsv(
  "../data/_raw/motrpac_pass1b-06_t55-gastrocnemius_prot-pr_vial-metadata_v2.0.txt"
)
```

## Load Phenotype Data

```{r}
phenotype_data <- read_tsv(
  "../data/_raw/motrpac_pass1b-06_pheno_viallabel_data_merged_v4.0.txt"
)
```

```{r}
proteomics_loaded <- bind_rows(
  cortex_proteomics |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = 10:69,
      names_to = "vial_label",
      values_to = "protein_abundance"
    ) |>
    mutate(tissue = "Cortex"),

  gastro_proteomics |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = 10:69,
      names_to = "vial_label",
      values_to = "protein_abundance"
    ) |>
    mutate(tissue = "Gastrocnemius"),

  heart_proteomics |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = 10:69,
      names_to = "vial_label",
      values_to = "protein_abundance"
    ) |>
    mutate(tissue = "Heart"),

  kidney_proteomics |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = 10:69,
      names_to = "vial_label",
      values_to = "protein_abundance"
    ) |>
    mutate(tissue = "Kidney"),

  liver_proteomics |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = 10:69,
      names_to = "vial_label",
      values_to = "protein_abundance"
    ) |>
    mutate(tissue = "Liver"),

  lung_proteomics |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = 10:69,
      names_to = "vial_label",
      values_to = "protein_abundance"
    ) |>
    mutate(tissue = "Lung"),

  white_adipose_proteomics |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = 10:69,
      names_to = "vial_label",
      values_to = "protein_abundance"
    ) |>
    mutate(tissue = "White adipose")
)
```

```{r}
write_tsv(
  proteomics_loaded,
  "../data/01_dat_load.tsv"
)
```
